label: New filing screen words

params.name: lede
params.default: Say who the return is for, see the documents it needs, drop them in - {product} reads each one, makes the client and asks only for what is missing.
params.label: lede

params.name: start_p
params.default: Pick who the return is for. Four short steps: nothing is filed for you, and you see every figure before the department's JSON is made.
params.label: start_p

params.name: start_points
params.default: Tell it what applies - in plain words|See the documents and where to get each|Drop them in - the client is made from them|Open the return at the right step
params.label: start_points

params.name: ny_company
params.default: A company's return (ITR-6) is made from Clients & years for now - add the company there, then Intake & map. The guided way in comes next; a director's own return starts here.
params.label: ny_company

params.name: ny_trust
params.default: Trust returns (ITR-7) are not in {product} yet. Meanwhile file the trustees' or the settlor's own returns here.
params.label: ny_trust

params.name: examples_p
params.default: One for each kind of return - watch it start to finish, with made-up documents.
params.label: examples_p

params.name: resume_h
params.default: Carry on where you left off
params.label: resume_h

params.name: resume_none
params.default: Nothing waiting - every filing you started is finished or discarded.
params.label: resume_none

params.name: discard_body
params.default: The wizard's progress is dropped. The client and every document already in its return stay where they are.
params.label: discard_body

params.name: what_p
params.default: Pick everything that fits - you can change it later. Not sure? Upload the documents: they say what else applies.
params.label: what_p

params.name: work_p
params.default: The business in plain words - it decides the documents, the form and whether a tax audit and Form 3CD are needed.
params.label: work_p

params.name: form_note
params.default: The documents' amounts settle it in My return - 112A gains up to 1.25 lakh still fit ITR-1, for one.
params.label: form_note

params.name: form_note_firm
params.default: A business files ITR-5 from its books; the tax audit's Form 3CD goes with it when the turnover needs one.
params.label: form_note_firm

params.name: why_e_audit
params.default: {form} with a tax audit: Form 3CA or 3CB with 3CD - the audit report by 30 September, the return by 31 October.
params.label: why_e_audit

params.name: why_e_44ad
params.default: {form} with the income on the presumptive basis (44AD / 44ADA) - no full books below the limits.
params.label: why_e_44ad

params.name: why_e_books
params.default: {form} from the books: trading or manufacturing account, profit and loss and the balance sheet, tagged in Intake & map.
params.label: why_e_books

params.name: docs_p
params.default: From what you picked. Each says what it is and where to get it; what you type in waits for later.
params.label: docs_p

params.name: up_p
params.default: PDF, JSON, CSV, Excel or a zip - several at once. Each is identified by what it is, never by its file name.
params.label: up_p

params.name: drop_hint
params.default: Form 16, AIS, 26AS, pre-filled JSON, CAMS or KFintech, GSTR-3B, last year's ITR
params.label: drop_hint

params.name: drop_hint_firm
params.default: GST certificate, partnership deed or LLP agreement, books in Excel, 26AS, AIS, GSTR-3B JSON, last year's ITR-5
params.label: drop_hint_firm

params.name: pw
params.default: Password of a locked PDF (if it is not PAN + date of birth)
params.label: pw

params.name: pw_ph
params.default: Leave blank for the usual one
params.label: pw_ph

params.name: cards_none
params.default: Nothing uploaded yet - the cards appear here as each file is read.
params.label: cards_none

params.name: to_gst
params.default: Into the tax audit's GST check
params.label: to_gst

params.name: other_p
params.default: Not a document {product} reads. It is kept here, not added to the return - remove it, or upload the right one.
params.label: other_p

params.name: other_pan_p
params.default: This names PAN {pan}, not {mine} - it was not added to this return.
params.label: other_pan_p

params.name: locked_p
params.default: Locked: type its password above and upload it again - or give the date of birth when asked, and it is opened again.
params.label: locked_p

params.name: already_p
params.default: The same file is there already - nothing added twice.
params.label: already_p

params.name: remove_body
params.default: It comes out of this filing and out of the return. The file itself is kept in History.
params.label: remove_body

params.name: client_wait
params.default: Not known yet - the first document with a PAN makes the client.
params.label: client_wait

params.name: client_found
params.default: Already in your register - the documents go to their return
params.label: client_found

params.name: pr_form16_more
params.default: TAN {tans} paid salary and has no Form 16 here - upload that employer's Form 16.
params.label: pr_form16_more

params.name: pr_cams
params.default: The AIS shows {amount} of share or mutual-fund sales - upload the CAMS / KFintech (or broker) capital-gains statement.
params.label: pr_cams

params.name: pr_property
params.default: 26AS shows TDS under section 194IA on a property sale of {amount} - enter the sale (deed figures, cost, any exemption) in My return.
params.label: pr_property

params.name: pr_vda
params.default: The AIS shows {amount} of crypto sold (194S) - enter each transfer in My return.
params.label: pr_vda

params.name: pr_business
params.default: {amount} of fees came with TDS under {sections} - add the business or profession.
params.label: pr_business

params.name: pr_gst
params.default: A business: upload the GSTR-3B summary, so the GST turnover sits beside the receipts.
params.label: pr_gst

params.name: pr_last_itr
params.default: Losses from last year: upload last year's ITR JSON - its Schedule CFL is read.
params.label: pr_last_itr

params.name: pr_foreign
params.default: Foreign income or assets: enter each account and holding in My return (Schedule FA).
params.label: pr_foreign

params.name: pr_arrears
params.default: Salary arrears: enter each earlier year's arrears in My return - the relief is worked out.
params.label: pr_arrears

params.name: pr_books
params.default: No books yet: upload the financial statements or the trial balance in Excel - each row is tagged in Intake & map.
params.label: pr_books

params.name: pr_gst_json
params.default: Registered for GST: upload the GSTR-3B (and GSTR-1) JSON - the tax audit sets the GST turnover against the books.
params.label: pr_gst_json

params.name: pr_deed
params.default: Partners: upload the partnership deed or LLP agreement - the partners, their shares and the pay it allows (s.40(b)).
params.label: pr_deed

params.name: pr_stock
params.default: Stock: the closing stock and its valuation are tagged with the books in Intake & map (Form 3CD clause 14).
params.label: pr_stock

params.name: pr_dep
params.default: Depreciation: tag the fixed-asset sheet in Intake & map - the blocks, additions and rates (s.32, Form 3CD clause 18).
params.label: pr_dep

params.name: pr_itr_prev
params.default: Last year's ITR-5 is here: bring it in on Import old returns with its acknowledgement number - it becomes last year's figures.
params.label: pr_itr_prev

params.name: pr_audit_3cd
params.default: A tax audit: the Tax audit screen walks Form 3CD by risk, with the GST check and this year against last.
params.label: pr_audit_3cd

params.name: ask_h
params.default: A few details the documents did not give
params.label: ask_h

params.name: ask_p
params.default: Everything else came from the documents. Change any of it later on the client or in its return.
params.label: ask_p

params.name: a_pan_pick_hint
params.default: The documents name more than one PAN.
params.label: a_pan_pick_hint

params.name: a_pan_hint
params.default: No document named one. The 4th letter is P for a person, H for an HUF, F for a firm or LLP, A for an AOP.
params.label: a_pan_hint

params.name: a_status
params.default: This PAN is not the return chosen
params.label: a_status

params.name: a_huf_name_hint
params.default: As on its PAN - for example, Demo Verma HUF.
params.label: a_huf_name_hint

params.name: a_dob_hint
params.default: It opens a locked AIS (PAN + date of birth) and decides the senior-citizen limits.
params.label: a_dob_hint

params.name: a_karta_pan_hint
params.default: An individual's PAN - its 4th letter is P.
params.label: a_karta_pan_hint

params.name: res_later
params.default: Work it out from the days
params.label: res_later

params.name: a_partners_hint
params.default: Name, PAN and profit share of each - as the deed says. Filled in from the deed when one is in.
params.label: a_partners_hint

params.name: a_company_hint
params.default: From its certificate of incorporation - check them; the rest (shareholders, the option's Form 10-IC) waits on Clients & years.
params.label: a_company_hint

params.name: a_gstin_hint
params.default: 15 characters - the state code, the PAN, then three more. On the GST certificate.
params.label: a_gstin_hint

params.name: rv_opens_firm
params.default: Then Reconcile, the tax audit and Compute & close
params.label: rv_opens_firm

params.name: rv_need_client
params.default: Upload a document with the PAN, or give it when asked - the return opens once the client is known.
params.label: rv_need_client

params.name: rv_checks_none
params.default: The documents agree with each other so far.
params.label: rv_checks_none

params.name: found_client
params.default: {name} - already a client; the documents go to their return
params.label: found_client

params.name: hero_p
params.default: Pick who the return is for - a person, an HUF, a firm, an LLP, an AOP or a company. Drop the documents in: {product} makes the client and fills the return.
params.label: hero_p

params.name: bad_who
params.default: Pick who this return is for.
params.label: bad_who

params.name: bad_pick
params.default: {id} does not apply to this return.
params.label: bad_pick

params.name: too_many
params.default: At most {n} documents in one filing.
params.label: too_many

params.name: too_many_open
params.default: At most {n} filings can wait at once - finish or discard one first.
params.label: too_many_open

params.name: bad_pan
params.default: {pan} is not a PAN - five letters, four digits, a letter.
params.label: bad_pan

params.name: bad_gstin
params.default: {gstin} is not a GSTIN - 15 characters, the PAN inside.
params.label: bad_gstin

params.name: bad_choice
params.default: {value} is not one of the choices.
params.label: bad_choice

params.name: self_other
params.default: Your desk files only your own return.
params.label: self_other

params.name: a_mobile
params.default: Your mobile number (10 digits) - the return needs one
params.label: a mobile

params.name: a_address
params.default: Your address (flat, street, area, city, PIN) - the return needs one
params.label: a address

params.name: bad_mobile
params.default: That is not a mobile number - 10 digits, starting 6, 7, 8 or 9.
params.label: bad mobile

params.name: a_email
params.default: Your e-mail address - the return and the portal's mails go here
params.label: a email

params.name: a_father
params.default: Your father's name - the return's declaration asks for it
params.label: a father

params.name: bad_email
params.default: That does not look like an e-mail address.
params.label: bad email
